SMU Classification: Restricted

I am writing to share an opportunity at Singapore Management University (SMU) that may interest you or colleagues in your network.

SMU is inviting applications for the Presidential Early Career Professorship (SMU-PEP) – a prestigious tenure-track position for outstanding early-career scholars. The scheme offers a generous sign-on bonus, start-up research funding, dedicated mentorship, and opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration. Candidates from all disciplines are welcome, with particular focus on SMU’s strategic research areas.

More information is available

. Applications are now open and will close on 15 October 2026 for the 2027 intake.

I would be grateful if you could share this with anyone in your network who may be a strong fit — and of course, I encourage you to consider applying yourself.
